title: Vellum preview, settle, and freeze
summary: Use a bounded preview-first Vellum stage to settle cloth or cables, then freeze or cache a validated result before game optimization.

use_when: flexible geometry needs a physically settled result
avoid_when: a direct deformation produces the required result
a live simulation was not requested

inputs: frame, scale, solver, and output policy
outputs: validated frozen geometry or versioned animation cache
optimized game geometry with preserved UV/material groups
acceptance: chosen frame or cache range is stable
rollback: write caches to a new version
never overwrite the source HIP implicitly
